The wind map for Belo Horizonte is open in your browser tab, but it shows all of Brazil rather than zooming in on the city. It's titled "Brazil Current Wind Speeds" and sits on AccuWeather's Radar & Maps page, under the Current Conditions tab, with the WIND layer selected.

I read the page text only. The map itself is a graphic I couldn't see, so I can't describe the wind pattern on it. Use the zoom buttons on the map to move in on Belo Horizonte. The same page also has Wind Gusts, Temperature and RealFeel layers.

Belo Horizonte's current conditions on AccuWeather are wind from the southwest at 5 mph, with gusts of 11 mph.

Two other things happened along the way. I accepted the site's cookie banner (and closed an ad pop-up) so I could use the page. I also tried a guessed wind-map address that returned a "page not found" error, so I went back and used the site's own links.
